submission.justification: Of all evaluated combinations, Mixture-G1 at a gas gap of 1.5 mm provides the best (lowest) time resolution of 0.916 ns, directly fulfilling the primary goal of achieving the best possible time resolution. This choice complies with the specified gas gap range constraint (1–3 mm) and mixture candidates, and assuming Mixture-G1 meets all environmental and safety requirements stated in the project documents.
